explanation: Beckoning someone with a single upturned index finger is associated with calling an animal and is considered disrespectful in China. The accepted alternative is to extend the hand palm-down and curl the fingers toward yourself in a waving motion.
local_tip: To call someone over, wave with your palm facing down and fingers curling inward, rather than crooking a single raised index finger.

also_check.note: Beckoning with a single finger is considered very rude and can even be treated as a provocation.
Beckoning with the index finger is seen as impolite; a palm-down wave with all fingers is the accepted alternative.
Beckoning with the index finger is common and unremarkable in casual settings.
